關於我們



As a next-generation stock investing assistant, we provide equity         作為新一代股票投資助手，我們面向廣大個
investment tools, securities investment advisory, investor education      人投資者提供股票投資工具、證券投資顧
and other services for individual investors with product offerings        問、投資者教育等服務，相繼推出股票行情
such as stock quote software, Stock Navigator, Super Investor,            軟件、股道領航、超級投資家、AI股票機、
Enjoy-Stock Pad, Jiuyao Stocks, Decision Master and Star-tier             九爻股、決策大師及星級服務等產品。
Services.

Implementing our “technology + investment research” dual-                 我們秉持「科技+投研」雙輪驅動戰略，基於
driver strategy, and leveraging artificial intelligence and big data      人工智能與大數據技術，打造九方靈犀AI投
technologies, we have developed FinSphere Agent, AI investment            顧智能體產品矩陣，聚焦核心投資服務場
advisory agent product portfolio. Centered on core investment             景，構建多智能體協同的投顧服務能力，實
service scenarios, we have established multi-agent collaborative          現行業領先的創新實踐與場景應用，致力於
investment advisory service capabilities, enabling us to achieve          成為客戶投資理財的終身伴侶。
industry-leading innovative practices and scenario applications.
We are committed to becoming a lifelong partner in investment and
wealth management for our customers.

Dear Shareholders,                                                       尊敬的各位股東：

During the Reporting Period, China’s domestic capital market             報告期內，國內資本市場於複雜環境中企穩
stabilized and improved amid a complex environment. Market-              向好，穩市機制持續完善，A股呈「N型」
                                                                                           震盪
stabilization mechanisms were continuously refined, and the A-share      上行，市場活力逐步釋放；「十五五」規劃明
market exhibited an “N-shaped” volatile upward trend, with market        確加快建設金融強國，數字金融納入國家戰
vitality gradually unleashed. The “15th Five-Year” Plan clearly          略佈局。我們始終響應、落實國家政策和監
specifies accelerated efforts to build a strong financial country, and   管要求，將政策導向融入經營全鏈，確保發
digital finance has been incorporated into national strategic layouts.   展方向與國家戰略、監管導向同頻共振，強
We consistently respond to and implement national policies and           化投資者教育與權益保護，以「人工智能+ 投
regulatory requirements, integrate policy orientation into the entire    顧」推動專業服務普惠化，引導理性投資，助
operational chain, and ensure our development stays aligned with         力資本市場與公司高質量發展。
national strategies and regulatory guidance. We strengthen investor
education and rights protection, leverage the “AI + investment
advisory” model to promote inclusive professional services, guide
rational investment, and support high-quality development of both
the capital market and the Company.

Benefiting from forward-looking strategic layouts and the                憑藉前瞻戰略佈局與全體同仁同心協力、篤
united efforts and pragmatic dedication of all employees, the            行實幹，公司2025年度經營穩健向好，業績
Company maintained sound and steady operations with sustained            持續增長。未來公司將堅持拓界創新與產品
performance growth in 2025. Adhering to boundary-expanding               迭代，立足本土、佈局全球，以「科技+ 投
innovation and continuous product iteration, the Company bases           研」雙輪驅動築牢長期發展動能，矢志「成為
itself domestically and expands global arrangements. Driven by the       客戶投資理財的終身伴侶」。
dual-driver of “technology + investment research”, we consolidate
long-term development momentum, striving to “become a lifelong
investment and wealth management partner for our customers”.


REVIEW OF YEAR 2025                                                      2025年度回顧
As a “next-generation stock investing assistant”, we remain              作為「新一代股票投資助手」，我們秉持「讓
steadfast in our mission of “making investment and wealth                投資理財更簡單、更專業，提升投資理財的

sense of happiness in investment and wealth management”. We              與長期投資理念。以科技創新為引領，深

Reasons for Adopting the Contractual Arrangements                        採納合約安排的原因
The current business of Shanghai Beixun and its subsidiaries             上海鋇勛及其附屬公司目前的業務包括在中
involves the provision of internet information services, audiovisual     國提供互聯網信息服務、視聽網絡服務及廣
network services and production of radio and television program          播電視節目製作服務，且上海鋇勛一直為其
services in the PRC, while Shanghai Beixun has also been providing       附屬公司提供管理支持及監督其業務營運。
management support and supervising the business operation of its         根據適用的中國法律法規並據本公司中國法
subsidiaries. According to the applicable PRC laws and regulations       律顧問所告知，(i)提供互聯網信息服務構成
and as advised by the Company’s PRC legal advisor, (i) internet          提供增值電信業務（增值電信業務），須受外
information services provided constitute provision of value-added        資所有權限制；及(ii)提供視聽網絡服務及廣
telecommunications business (增值電信業務), which are subject                  播電視節目製作服務，屬於「信息網絡視聽
to foreign ownership restriction, and (ii) provision of audiovisual      節目服務」
                                                                             （信息網絡視聽節目服務）及「廣播
network services and production of radio and television program          電視節目製作經營業務」  （廣播電視節目製作
services falls within the scope of “service of audiovisual programs      經營業務）的範疇，禁止外商投資。
on information networks” (信息網絡視聽節目服務) and “radio and
television program production and operation business” (廣播電視節
目製作經營業務), which prohibit foreign investment.

(1)      Purpose                                                                      (1)   目的
         The purpose of the 2025 Share Incentive Scheme is to attract                       2025年股份激勵計劃旨在吸引並挽留
         and retain outstanding talents, to reward the selected persons                     傑出人才以及嘉許經選定人士為本集團
         for their services and contributions to the success of the                         的成功提供的服務及作出的貢獻，並激
         Group, and to provide incentives to them to further contribute                     勵彼等繼續為本集團作出貢獻。
         to the Group.

(2)      Awards                                                                       (2)   獎勵

         Share Incentive Scheme (“Award(s)”) gives the participant a                        份單位（「受限制股份單位」）獎勵（「獎

         Shares or an equivalent value in cash with reference to the                        勵歸屬時獲取由董事會參考歸屬日期或
         market value of the Shares underlying such Award on or                             前後有關獎勵涉及的股份的市值而全權
         about the date of vesting, as determined by the Board at                           酌情釐定的股份或等值現金。當本公司
         its sole discretion. When the Company grants Awards to a                           向承授人授予獎勵時，承授人將被視為
         Grantee, the Grantee will be deemed to have accepted the                           已接納該等獎勵。承授人於接納該等獎
         Awards. The Grantee shall not be required to pay any amount                        勵時毋須支付任何款項。
         upon acceptance of the Awards.

         An award of options under the 2025 Share Incentive Scheme                          根據2025年股份激勵計劃授出的購股

Risk Management                                                               風險管理
The Group has established a climate risk management process,                  本集團已建立氣候風險管理流程，持續關注
continuously monitoring the impact of climate change on business              由於氣候變化對業務營運帶來的影響，通過
operations, and actively identifying, assessing and managing                  積極識別、評估和管理潛在的氣候風險及機
potential climate risks and opportunities, developing monitoring              遇，制定監測機制與應急預案，實現對於氣
mechanisms and contingency plans, to achieve dynamic                          候風險的動態管理、及時預警與有效應對，
management, timely early warning and effective response to climate            從而提升公司整體的氣候韌性。
risks, thereby enhancing the Company’s overall climate resilience.

Climate Risk and Opportunity Identification: Identifying climate              氣候風險與機遇識別：基於外部氣候相關政
risks and opportunities that may impact the Group based on                    策及行業發展趨勢，通過利益相關方溝通、
external climate-related policies, industry development trends and            同業對標、市場調研等方式，結合自身運營
its own operation status through stakeholder communication, peer              現狀，識別可能對我們產生影響的氣候風險
benchmarking and market research, thereby initially establishing a            和機遇，初步建立本集團氣候風險與機遇清
list of the Group’s climate-related risks and opportunities.                  單。

Climate Risk and Opportunity Assessment: Based on the Company’s               氣候風險與機遇評估：基於公司業務和戰
business and strategy, assessing climate-related risks and opportunities      略，從短、中、長期時間範圍對氣候相關風
over short-, medium – and long-term time horizons, determining                險及機遇進行評估，確定潛在影響和優先順
potential impacts and priorities, and identifying significant climate risks   序，識別重大氣候風險和機遇。
and opportunities.

Climate Risk Response: Developing risk contingency plans and                  氣候風險應對：制定風險應急預案，並落實
implementing departmental responsibilities, to enable the rapid               各部門職責，能夠迅速啟動內部應急流程，
activation of internal emergency procedures and the coordinated               統籌調度資源。
deployment of resources.
